description: TCS-6 Crypto Treasury Capital Score. Paid, derived treasury analysis for DeFi protocols and DAOs: six weighted dimensions (net realizable capital scale, liquidity runway, obligation coverage, stress resilience, replenishment, control/governance), five hard gates, realization haircuts on every asset class, and a cited source manifest. POST /v1/tcs6/score {entity_id} returns the full report; POST /v1/tcs6/entities {} lists the curated registry. Reports are recomputed by a background pipeline every 12h and served from cache, so results are deterministic between refreshes but change across them. Every response, success or error, is a single JSON object. Output is derived values and citations only, never raw vendor data. Research score, not investment advice.

rpc_types.notes: POST /v1/tcs6/score, /v1/tcs6/entities; GET /v1/version, /v1/health. JSON body only. Unknown entity_id or malformed input returns 400 + JSON. Thin evidence is a 200 with analysis_status insufficient_data, never an error.

serving.backend: Node.js HTTP server (zero npm dependencies) behind a RelayMiner at http://<container>:8080. No caller auth. Relay path is a file-cache read; a separate pipeline process computes reports every 12h from evidence pushed by a private collector.

healthcheck.notes: Readiness probe; body also reports last_pipeline_run.
Functional probe with a deterministic expected value.

serving.notes: Gateway operators: configure as type passthrough with rpc_types ["rest"].
